summary: Re-tested the HIGH fix from iteration_1 (unreachable customer Location/Address picker) and the MEDIUM toast-key collision fix. All primary checks PASS. Location picker is now fully reachable and functional: the customer header exposes both data-testid='open-location-picker' (desktop) and data-testid='open-location-picker-top' (top bar), both calling setIsDistanceModalOpen(true). Clicking either opens the DistanceSelectorModal with the 'Delivery Distance & Address' title, Full Name / Phone / Pincode / Street Address form, custom distance slider, and Zone A/B/C presets. The 'Open Google Maps Precise Location Picker' launcher opens the MapLocationPicker with 2 iframes, a Search input, a 'Locate Me (GPS)' button, and the address form. On Save, the modal closes and the header pill updates to the new pincode (verified: 560034 -> 560099, single 'Location updated' toast). Zero React 'two children with the same key' console errors observed during this session (previous iteration observed ~20).

ui_bugs.issue: In the Google Maps Precise Location Picker modal, the bottom 'Cancel' button and the header ✕ close button are not reliably clickable via Playwright's normal click because a sibling required <input> (Street Address / Landmark) inside the same scrolling form intercepts pointer events (Playwright reports: 'input ... intercepts pointer events'). A JS/programmatic click works, so this is a stacking / actionability issue in the modal layout (likely the scrollable <form class=p-6 overflow-y-auto> containing both the required inputs and the action buttons, without a dedicated sticky footer). Real users on smaller viewports could hit the same obstruction. Recommend moving Cancel / Confirm Google Maps Location into a sticky footer <div> OUTSIDE the scrolling form (or wrapping them in a positioned container with a higher z-index) so they are always tappable regardless of form scroll position.
ui_bugs.selector: MapLocationPicker.tsx lines 379 (✕) and 804 (Cancel) inside <form class=p-6 overflow-y-auto>

ui_bugs.component: DistanceSelectorModal — distance slider vs header distance display
ui_bugs.issue: Programmatically setting the Custom Distance slider to 15 and clicking Save updates the pincode in the header correctly, but the header still shows '5.2 km' (i.e., the previously-saved distance). Either the slider input's onChange isn't updating the modal's local state that gets saved, or the header derives distance from a different stored field. Manual click-drag by a user may still work; worth confirming with a real drag/click on the slider track.
Still using cdn.tailwindcss.com in index.html — console prints the production warning. Move to the PostCSS/CLI build already configured in tailwind.config.js / postcss.config.js.

action_items: In MapLocationPicker.tsx, lift the Cancel / Confirm Google Maps Location buttons out of the scrolling <form class=p-6 overflow-y-auto> into a sticky (or absolutely-positioned) footer so they never end up behind/next to required inputs that intercept pointer events. Same for the header ✕ close button (ensure the header has isolation/z-index or pointer-events: auto over the form).

Verify the DistanceSelectorModal slider actually updates the persisted 'distanceKm' when saved; header still shows the old 5.2 km after a slider change while the pincode change persists (minor, may only affect programmatic slider updates).
Move Tailwind off the CDN (production warning) — low priority, already flagged in iteration_1.
critical_code_review_comments: MapLocationPicker's action bar living inside the scrollable form creates an actionability trap when required inputs are empty — refactor into a sticky footer outside <form>.
App.tsx still >660 lines — consider splitting role-specific views (already flagged in iteration_1).

rca_of_the_issue: iteration_1 HIGH bug root cause was that setIsDistanceModalOpen(true) was never invoked. This has been fixed by making both header location pills into <button> elements with onOpenLocationPicker={() => setIsDistanceModalOpen(true)} passed from App.tsx to Header.tsx, and exposing data-testid='open-location-picker' / 'open-location-picker-top'. iteration_1 MEDIUM duplicate-key toast IDs was fixed by switching from `Date.now().toString()` to `${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`. Both fixes verified in-browser.
